# Blank lines are requested with ensureBlankLine and only materialized before
# the next item; they are prevented at the start of a file and after
# preventBlankLine; indentation changes apply from the next line on.
input json TopLevel {"a": 1}

render probe {} script
blank 2
line ["first (no blank lines before it)"]
blank 1
blank 3
line ["after three blank lines"]
indent 1
line ["indented"]
line [""]
line []
blank 1
line []
line ["after a bare newline, then a blank"]
prevent
blank 2
line ["prevented"]
indent -1
line ["dedented"]
indented
line ["block"]
indented
line ["nested ", {"top": "TopLevel"}]
end
end
blank 1
end

render probe {"indentation": "\t"} script
line ["tabs"]
indented
line ["a", "b", ["c", ["d"]]]
blank 1
line [{"nl": 1}, "x"]
line ["y"]
end
end

render probe {} script
multiline "first\n    four\n\n        eight\n\ttab\n    \tspaces then tab\n   \nback"
line ["after"]
end

render probe {} script
multiline "a\n  two spaces"
end

render probe {} script
indent 1
end
